answer_4.quote: Human Evaluation We also assessed system performance by eliciting human judgments on 100 randomly selected test instances on QQP dataset. Three annotators are asked to rate paraphrasing questions generated by T5-CLAPS, DialoGPT, Seq2Seq-DU, and our model according to Fluency (Flu), Meaningfulness (Mean), and Differential (Diff).
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rated generated paraphrases on Fluency, Meaningfulness, and Differential using a scale from 1 to 3.
